notes: Closing Ashlight now fades the window out smoothly, whether it goes to the tray or exits. It closes instantly if you turn motion off.

Ttool is now Ashlight, and your settings come with it. Game profiles switch your colour, crosshair and more when a game is in front. Settings backups: daily, before big changes, and save or open them as a file. Crosshair codes to copy and paste a look. Suggest something from Settings and see when it's accepted. Chat keeps up after a lost connection: missed messages, unsent ones and calls come back by themselves. Safer: Windows settings are put back even if Ashlight crashes.

Library: your Steam and Epic games in one place, with covers and one-click play. Share: stream your screen to friends with a link, up to 1080p60. A new welcome, round zoom lens with sharper zoom, 6 new crosshairs with screen fitting and a dynamic spread, type exact numbers on any slider, smoke background, and a new heading font.
Ashlight now leaves your NVIDIA vibrance alone until you move the Vibrance slider or turn on Control NVIDIA vibrance.

Discord now shows just Playing Ashlight with a Get Ashlight button. The colour darkener takes the exact colour to full dark, with a Pick from screen button. Stats and performance overlays are removed, so Ashlight does less in the background.
A simpler welcome that says hello in many languages. The crosshair preview no longer covers the reticle settings when you scroll, and previews use a plain grey background.
Messages from the Ashlight team can now be info, update or important, and can end on a date.
Cleaner previews: the crosshair preview uses a real photo instead of a drawn backdrop.

Intro when opening, sign in with Discord or a name, and a greeting on Home. Window buttons can be macOS or Windows style, on either side. The app now checks itself against the official build. Fewer words everywhere, a cleaner aspect ratio page, and smoother scrolling.

New look with macOS-style window buttons, a welcome tour, and messages and update notices on Home. Aspect ratio now stretches without changing your resolution. Custom colour picker and dropdowns, better keybinds (Esc clears), a new Utilities page with Game boost, see-through liquid glass, Discord status, and fixes for small memory leaks.
The website is online, and Ashlight now checks it for updates.

New Colour page with shadows, highlights, blacks, whites and tints that go minus and plus. Colour darkener with a wheel, saved looks, picture, GIF and video backgrounds with see-through panels, a quick panel, hiding overlays from recordings and more settings.
Rebuilt in Zig and about 100 times smaller. GPU zoom on your main screen only, new music and performance HUD options, aspect ratio controls, 24 themes and a new setup.
Music HUD gets background transparency, blur, corners, lyric size and glow. Outlines removed and themes added.
